content: Use a proper measuring spoon or device to ensure you are taking the correct dose of this medication. Do not use a household spoon, as it may not provide an accurate measurement. If you are using the liquid form, measure the dose carefully with the provided dropper or a dose-measuring device. Take this medication only when necessary and strictly follow the prescribed dosage. Do not increase the dose, take it more frequently, or use it for a longer duration than directed by your healthcare provider. This medication is intended for temporary relief of constipation. It works as a stool softener by increasing the amount of water absorbed by the stool in the gut, making it softer and easier to pass. To prevent constipation, incorporate dietary fiber into your meals, drink sufficient water, and engage in regular physical activity. Common side effects may include stomach pain, diarrhea, or cramping. If you are using the liquid or syrup form, throat irritation may also occur. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you experience any unusual or severe symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor if you are breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of this medication or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222 for assistance. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company for guidance on safe disposal. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your individual health needs.
